  2. 2

    Set up Jason's house

    SetupJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbMedium priority

    Strength (max health): lift the heaviest weights on the back deck, resting between reps until the game says you need to recover; no gym needed. Cardio (max stamina): hang the punching bag from the storage room / shed and punch until the session ends. Focus (slow-motion time): shoot hoops in the driveway or feed Dolores the snake. Have some protein after a workout: it speeds recovery so you can train twice a day (Caspahz). Then sleep in your bed to skip to the next day and train again; the stats video says this maxes Strength and Cardio in a couple of hours. Read the Fishing Magazine and check the mailbox for cash. Repairing the house raises your relationship with LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb; leaving the walls unpainted lowers it a little. Jay Dunna's Chapter 1 walkthrough: repair the house before Lucia comes home (walls, the deck by the door, the stairs, the leaky roof via the ladder, then paint), and hang the hidden punching bag for a home workout spot she likes. Feed Dolores, and do Lucia's shopping, flowers and clothes from AndyFirst appearance · CharacterAndyPlayed by Mallory WuMallory Wu on IMDb before picking her up.

    More detail (1)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
    • Jason's home weights count as a workout: any three sets, then sleep 24 hours. Three such days make one level, and 12 days max Strength (Griff Griffin).

    Reward / unlocks: Stats that carry through the game (JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's Strength and Cardio reset at the end of Chapter 1)

  4. 4

    Get around faster: grab a helicopter

    SetupJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbMedium priority

    There is no real fast travel. A pontoon helicopter is docked at a small building in Pelican ValleyReal lifeEverglades swamp country west of HomesteadBest guess from the name and fan comparisons. (closest to JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's house; the NPCs there shoot a little) and another floats at an oil/gas platform further north; the Southwind airfield has one too. Land it in the water by Jason's dock and drop the anchor from the vehicle menu. It cannot be refuelled, so treat it as a burner, and land away from enemy camps. Also useful: saving and immediately loading that save puts you back at home, and holding down on the D-pad then the cinematic button lets the car or boat auto-drive to your waypoint. Once you have the RideMe app, request a ride, hold aim on the driver and hold Triangle / Y to skip the trip for $100. 'H' markers on the map are helicopter spawns, but they come and go with the time of day.

  5. 5

    Gear Up

    StoryJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbHigh priority

    Unlocks gun shops and loadouts. Buy a suppressor and a body armor vest (it breaks if fully depleted, but re-equipping it repairs it). Pick up a bandana, hat and sunglasses and two or three outfits: toggle the accessories off from the item wheel when the cops have your description, and save outfits to your car to swap during a chase. Weapon colours: blue = bought (kept forever, moddable), yellow = unique (kept forever, fixed mods), white = found (lost if you die or are busted; the trunk keeps one per weapon type). Away from the car you carry two long guns. Sheriff cars carry a free armor vest and guns in the trunk. If the cops saw your weapon, stash it in your trunk; if they know your face, hold Circle / B to duck while driving.

  6. 6

    Know your criminal profile (one tier is permanent)

    SetupBothHigh priority

    JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb and LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb each have their own profile, set by how violently you play. Professional (start) and Hardened: incapacitating shots (yellow markers) and stealth takedowns refill Focus, you can surrender at low wanted levels (R1 / RB), and police mostly use tasers. Violent: headshots refill Focus instead. Psycho: no surrender, more lethal police. All four can be moved between. Keep going as a Psycho after the cracked-icon warnings and you become Irredeemable for the rest of the game: no Focus refills at all, police shoot at any crime, no surrender, and the video says some endings are no longer available for Psycho or Irredeemable. Lower your profile with good deeds: helping strangers, petting stray cats, throwing away trash. Newer videos agree: Irredeemable cannot be undone on that save and changes the story and endings, so make a manual save before going on a spree (JorRaptor). Full details on the Criminal profile page.

  8. 8

    Gun Nut house next door: sniper, LMG, rocket launcher, body armor

    LootJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbHigh priority

    The house about 0.1 mi from JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's, reachable straight after Pipework. Kick the door in upstairs; the owner is armed. Inside: the unique Gun Nut SMS-01 sniper, a wallet, frag grenades, a Mustang revolver, a safe in the first bedroom (about $250), a scoped 556 rifle on the owner, a shotgun behind the shower and a rocket launcher in the bathroom (climb into the tub), body armor on the bed, a light machine gun, and adrenaline in the garage. You can only carry so many long guns, so pick between the rifle, LMG and rocket launcher (store the rest in your trunk). Two videos show it; one says some players find the house empty, and Detonated still lists the Gun Nut SMS-01 as not found.

    Clear the Key Lento robbery spots

    MoneyJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbHigh priority

    Kingfishers Fishing Shacks: DonnieFirst appearance · CharacterDonniePlayed by Brad CarterBrad Carter on IMDb texts you about this camp early in the story. Approach by boat, thin them out with a sniper, then loot the main hut: the Kingfishers W-22 (unique, built-in silencer) is in the weapon crate, there is cash under the floorboards, and two non-unique guns (Duke 556, Laird 350) lie around the camp. One video puts the haul at about $10K including product. Every Kingfisher camp has a unique in its main building, but only while the gang is there: if you missed it, wait for them to regroup.     Carry your cash into Chapter 2, or spend it

    MissableJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbHigh priority

    At the end of Chapter 1 you lose your stash, BuckMe balance and cars, including stash bags in any trunk; Family Savings (max $5,000) stays. The videos disagree on cash in JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's pockets. One says it survives and that it was triple-checked: sell every stash bag, wait for the BuckMe payment, withdraw it all at an ATM, and empty the house stash before the yacht job with MattiaFirst appearance · CharacterMattia TauroPlayed by Massi PregoniMassi Pregoni on IMDb and Kat. The warning sign is LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb asking whether to call Mattia about the job; say no to buy time. Two other videos and Game8 say all cash is lost and recommend spending it on things that carry over: tattoos and piercings, and guns bought at Ammu-Nation. Make a manual save first either way. Jason's lock box rainy-day envelope and photos can be collected in Chapter 2. A third video (Caspahz) says only the house stash is lost and to move it into the bank, but Game8 and the first video say the BuckMe balance is wiped too.

Choices

Hey Arnold!Kill or spare Arnold? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Spare him. Sparing gives Jason a Restrained criminal profile and a chance to meet Arnold again. Game8 says it pays an extra $10K in Chapter 4; another source calls that payout disputed. Killing gives a Hardened profile.

Steal the Scooter (optional)Steal Peggy's scooter? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Your call. Stealing it lets you drive Shirley's Penumbra in Chapter 1 but can give a wanted level. Skipping it is safe.

Day ReleaseMention Brian's retirement? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Mention it. Raises the relationship and Lucia is supportive afterwards. Staying quiet lowers it during Recalibration.

Day ReleaseShake Mattia's hand / accept the drugs / which dress? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Any. No visible effect. The dress only sets what Lucia wears clubbing in Vice City.

Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove (optional)Shoot Mr. Mangrove, shoot Kirk, or neither? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Shoot Mr. Mangrove. The only option that pays: Kirk sends you $5,000. The other two give no reward.

    More detail (4)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
    • Ambulance Chaser: save first. Make sure the ambulance burns before you leave; otherwise it ends up crashed at Emerald Springs.
    • Just Moved In: the shopping costs $55. If Linda has to come to you, the rent rises to $1,080. She only takes cash.

  3. 3

    Before Moses: raid La Cascara Motel for a free Dominator

    StealthStealth tips
    • Go at night: it is easier to stay unseen (Jay Dunna).
    • Crouch along the south side of the 2nd floor and use Focus to see who is looking; two gang members need taking down quietly, the second from the side path by the grow operation (Its Shatter).
    • Take guards from behind: choke them out, or pistol-whip with a suppressed pistol out (Jay Dunna).
    • If the alarm goes up, pull them through the choke point north of the safe room and drop them with knee and elbow shots (Its Shatter).
    • Leave by dropping through the broken floors; the police arrive after the noise (Jay Dunna).
    LootLuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDbHigh priority

    After Girl's Trip, MosesFirst appearance · CharacterMoses "Mo" WatkinsPlayed by Aaron MortonAaron Morton on IMDb' first registration is free, so bring him the best car you can. The derelict La Cascara Motel near Gellhorn Outfitters (Kolt & Associates gang) has the red/black Vapid Firebug Dominator out front: nitrous, no tracker. Stealth route: 2nd floor south side, metal stairs on the west to the 3rd floor, the caved-in ceiling as a ramp to the 4th. The Lieutenant's room safe is 6969 (about $3,000) and a gun case on the way to the north stairwell holds the Scrapper VF5C, a suppressed SMG that is great for non-lethal takedowns. Leave through the hole in the floor past the locked gate, take the Dominator and jump the water from the trailer park; Moses is about 0.3 miles away. If it is not your free car it costs about $3,000 to register. Three videos agree on the code and the car. Jay Dunna adds a grenade launcher on the top floor and an LMG on a lower floor, and says the Dominator respawns out front a few days later if you leave it. Go at night and escape by dropping through the broken floors.

    Recommended loadout
    • A suppressed pistol (switch to whoever has one)
    • Body armour
    • Sticky bombs for the blocked stairwell (gun shop or grenade launcher also work)
    • Then the
      Scrapper VF5CScrapper VF5CCompact SMGIllegal Operation: La Cascara MotelChapter 2
      you find here: suppressed SMG, good for non-lethal takedowns

    Reward / unlocks: Vapid Firebug Dominator, Scrapper VF5C, ~$3,000

    Watch videoMap

    Moses

    StoryLuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDbHigh priority

    The top-priority mission of the chapter. Unlocks selling and registering vehicles and gives you the Slim Jim (opens cars without the alarm). Your FIRST registration is free: choose Register, not Sell, and bring a standout car (the Firebug Dominator from La Cascara, or Paul Walker's Penumbra FF from a Vespucci Island garage; otherwise either costs $3,000 to $6,750). Scan with WAiNK first: the tracker must be 'none' at this stage, and cars stolen right next to his shop can be refused. Hover his map icon to see whether he takes a car and the price. Vans sell for the most, then trucks. For robberies consider a van: vans hold 10 stash bags, many cars only 2 (Caspahz). MosesCharacterMoses "Mo" WatkinsPlayed by Aaron MortonAaron Morton on IMDb' respray removes unique liveries and names.

    Level Focus to max at Rodgers Ranch

    SetupBothMedium priority

    On the north-east edge of Port GellhornReal lifePanama City and the Panhandle61 of 97 GTADB landmark matches here are in Panama City.. Pay the clerk $5 for the Waiver Pass, start Market Range Beginner (pistol course, about 5 seconds, rent a pistol for $10 if needed), then quit and restart on repeat: every run adds permanent Focus (longer slow motion). JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb and LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb level separately, so bring both once switching opens. Single source (tech4gamers); how many runs per level is not confirmed. The stats video prefers fishing in deep water for Focus instead (free from the start; buy better bait at Ammu-Nation, and use Focus to see where the fish are). Newer videos: about +2% Focus per run until level 3, then about +1% (Jay Dunna); the animal range works too, and hitting targets counts even without a medal, so use Restart rather than quitting (Joe Hammer). Gold medals in every range unlock the M306 TMR rifle in the shop.

    Reward / unlocks: Permanent Focus; golds count toward The Shootist

  20. 20

    Rebuild Strength and Cardio

    SetupBothLow priority

    Unlike Focus, Strength and Cardio drop if you skip workouts. Lift the heaviest weights at the safe house (no gym needed), use the punching bag for Cardio, then sleep to skip to the next day and go again. Running, swimming, biking and gym machines also count. Free drinks and apples give temporary boosts above your max.

    More detail (3)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
    • The quickest routine (Griff Griffin): three sets a day, sleep, repeat; 12 workouts max a stat. Set Tap assist to Hold (x4) and turn on Simplified Mini Games so sets never fail.
    • Train together once switching opens: both characters level at once on one membership, and protein bars handed over add relationship hearts.
    • Eat a protein bar if the Fitness app says 'Hungry' (it cuts gains), drink from the fountain when Stamina runs low, and use the punching bag for fast Cardio.
    Watch videoIGN: Max Muscle FAST (video) ↗
  21. 21

    Brooks Boatworks map, then Kingpin Bowling

    StealthStealth tips
    • Come in through the gap in the fence on the right-hand side, away from the guards (CovertMF, Jay Dunna).
    • Crouch-walk and pick gang members off one by one with a suppressed gun; take the one on the stairs with a stealth takedown (CovertMF, Jay Dunna).
    • If it goes loud, get into cover and use Focus to line up shots; you can often still leave quietly, or jump into the water (CovertMF).
    • PC Gamer: stealth is a good choice here, but go in heavily armed anyway.
    • Jay Dunna does Kingpin Bowling loud: knee shots at the front, cover, then out the back.
    MoneyBothHigh priority

    Do Brooks Boatworks first: sneak in through the gap in the fence on the right-hand side; the upstairs office (outside stairs) has the Clunker 556 assault rifle and the wall map with the safe codes for Brooks, the motel and Kingpin Bowling. The Boatworks safe is upstairs in the main boathouse (pool-table room). The Vapid Smuggler Caracara outside is a unique truck that carries 6 stash bags. Kingpin Bowling: safe 0300, an Orca luxury watch in the office and the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the pool table; escaping with all three gives the Let's Go Bowling trophy, and it reopens later. Jay Dunna gives the Boatworks safe code as 6823, and the notepad in the police-raid safe (see the random encounter step) shows the same number; both come from auto-transcribed videos, so check the wall map if it fails. The Boatworks top floor also has sticky bombs, a grenade launcher and a rocket launcher, and there is a custom truck outside; jump into the water to escape.

    More detail (3)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
    • Backroom Weed Front (Pearl House Hair Salon, south Port Gellhorn, south-east of Pawn & Gun): a no-code safe in the back room and five bags of weed.
    • Industrial Weed Grow (north-west of Grassrivers, by Tola Bay; it only shows on the map once you're close): the Vapid Cultivator Sandking is unlocked in the middle of the warehouse (register $6,300, sells for about $16,170), a no-code safe in the west office, the Chronic Vatra SMG in the east armory, and 14 bags of weed.
    • Nova Auto Junkyard (M7, north-east Hamlet, east of Layin' Ink): the Marabunta Grande KZ-59 is under the north awning by the blue container. The safe code is written on the wall behind the safe. The Albany Teniente Manana is in the garage (no tracker; register $1,450).
    Recommended loadout
    • A suppressor on your favourite gun (gun-store mod section)
    • Body armour from the equipment menu
    • A food buff, Zombix and a vape for Focus
    • Sticky bombs or grenades for the safes (CovertMF, JorRaptor)

    More detail (5)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
    • Dre'Quan offers play money: take it for a few extra minutes in the club, or decline for a shorter mission. Nothing else changes.
    • From now on Pay 'n' Spray garages buy stolen cars; the Ubermacht '85 Sentinel you arrive in sells for about $1,760.

    • You can't switch to Lucia until Dealer's Choice is done.

Vanessa's WhatUp message gives code 92665 for a garage behind the closed Auntie's Place in La Perle (go through the motel lot next to Aline's Thrift Store): a pink Pfister Growler and the Del Rio Boulevard Garage, both free.

Drive to the antiques store in CapriReal lifecentral Florida towns like Sebring and Lakeland27 of 55 GTADB landmark matches here are in Sebring., where Benedict HalifaxFirst appearance · CharacterBenedict HalifaxPlayed by Ian Scott McGregorIan Scott McGregor on IMDb offers to appraise the statue.     Where in LeonidaReal lifeFlorida1 of 7 GTADB landmark matches here are in Pensacola Beach.: Antique store in CapriReal lifecentral Florida towns like Sebring and Lakeland27 of 55 GTADB landmark matches here are in Sebring.; Sweet Bay Inn motel (room 111); Maryam's house in north-west Capri; the boardwalk

    More detail (4)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
    • Give the statue to Halifax the first time to get the Crowex Octane 'Bobby Ambrose' watch, a missable cosmetic. Refusing keeps the statue but you never get the watch.
    • Part 2 (Find Halifax): the quiet way in is the stairs behind the shop and over the roof to an open window; the loud way is the front door. The clue is Halifax's planner on the desk by the window.
    • Outside room 111: 'Don't trust' finishes the mission now; 'Trust' pauses it until you return to the antique store.
    • Don't lose him in the boat and scooter chase. He then takes you to his lockup: take the statue and the other valuables in his storage unit.

He offers some of the best rates for robbery goods. Rewards the Snap Gun (quick, quiet lockpicking) and opens jewelry store robberies. Jay Dunna: do the store with no back entrance first (the Snap Gun is no help there; office code 1680 in his run), then Donovan Banks & Co, then the last one; the Snap Gun sits in Yasmani's back room after the first job (about $6,300 plus the jewelry). Destroy the footage every time.

    Where in LeonidaReal lifeFlorida1 of 7 GTADB landmark matches here are in Pensacola Beach.: Richardson Jewelry (Downtown Vice CityReal lifeDowntown Miami and Brickell105 of 105 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.), Donovan Banks & Co (Peacock BayReal lifeCoconut Grove, famous for its wild peacocks36 of 52 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.), Casa de Empeno (Ocean BeachReal lifeSouth Beach and Ocean Drive283 of 289 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami Beach.)

    More detail (6)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
    • Richardson Jewelry: diamond ring, at least $9,000. The safe is in the room behind the shop by the windows; the code is on a sticky note on the lit workbench in the far back room. The alarm panel is in that back room and the footage sits under a whiteboard behind the shop. The back alley door is alarmed.
    • Donovan Banks & Co: amethyst necklace, about $4,700. The safe is beside the fridge under the TV; the code is on a green note above the office desk, and the alarm panel and footage are in the office too. The back garage door opens without an alarm.
    • Casa de Empeno: buffalo skull chain, about $6,300. Safe, alarm and footage are all in the office; the code is on a green note on the staff-room cork board. The front door is the only way out.
    • Your first job unlocks the Snap Gun (opens locked doors quietly). The second unlocks pickup from your garage, which pays less.
    • Sell to Yasmani as soon as you lose the cops: if you die or get arrested, the haul in the trunk is gone.
    • Destroy the footage (Focus finds it) and park with the trunk open by your exit. Sticky Bombs open coded safes without the code.

Choices

Welcome to Vice CityTake the money? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Either. Taking it means spending all of it on the dancers before you can continue. Declining skips ahead to meeting Boobie.

Dealer's ChoicePure or Cut product? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Pure (no fight). Pure: the deal goes off without a hitch. Cut: Game8's choices page says you get only half the money and may fight the buyers with a wanted level, but its chapter walkthrough says Cut pays more. The two Game8 pages disagree.

Dealer's ChoiceWhich song hook? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Either. Only changes the lyrics of 'Cooties' on the radio and in cutscenes.

Dubious ProvenanceGive the statue to Halifax? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Give it. He hands you a watch as collateral and the story moves on. Refusing only delays it: you have to return to Capri and give it to him anyway.

Dubious ProvenanceTrust Halifax? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Trust him (faster). Game8's choices page: trusting avoids a delay of a few days; not trusting means waiting for Evelyn to call and tell you he is a scammer. Game8's walkthrough says the opposite, so sources disagree.

Dubious ProvenanceKill or spare Halifax? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Either. You get his stash both ways. Killing raises your criminal profile, sparing lowers it.

Safe WordJoin the movie shoot? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Do not join. Raises the relationship. Joining lowers it; the cutscene afterwards is the same.

Robberies and vault codes

Banks, jewelry stores and other big scores by area, best payout first: how to do each one, what to bring, and the vault, safe or door code. Then every code on the companion map.

Rules that save you money

  1. HighPocket cash caps at $20,000 per character and is lost on Busted/Wasted; bank it at an ATM into BuckMe right after escaping.gtabase.comgames.gg
  2. MediumGetting busted or killed also costs unowned weapons, a small BuckMe fee and most likely any stash bags you carry.gtabase.com
  3. HighBank, Payday Loans and some stash cash is marked bills: unspendable until fenced, needs the Ch3 Dye Pack Jammer or dye packs can burst.powerpyx.commeowdb.comxboxplay.games
  4. HighHeat by target: stores 1-2 stars, jewelry/pawn higher, vault banks an instant 4 stars. A red heat zone lingers after stars clear.games.ggpowerpyx.comvideogameschronicle.com
  5. HighCops remember outfit, car, visible weapons, your partner and CCTV. Mask up, swap clothes/car, respray, or split Jason and Lucia.gtabase.comgames.gg
  6. HighOn-site CCTV (camera icon) can be wiped at the recorder; cloud CCTV (cloud icon) cannot, so shoot the camera instead.meowdb.comgtabase.com
  7. MediumAlarms call police instantly; cut them first at the white security panel in the back office for a quiet job.meowdb.comxboxplay.games
  8. HighFree-roam store/bank safe codes are random per save; threaten staff and pick 'Safe Code?' or read sticky notes and PCs.beebom.comgames.ggxboxplay.games
  9. HighNo code? Use Break Open on small safes or explosives on big ones; explosives damage part of the loot.games.ggmeowdb.com
  10. MediumRobbed spots close or empty for a while; stores reopen and gang sites restock. Hitting early pays less. No exact timer published.games.ggmeowdb.compowerpyx.com
  11. MediumBest fences: Yasmani (Little Cuba) for jewelry and marked bills, Tyrone (La Perle) for drugs. Brian/Donnie pay very little.beebom.comgames.gg
  12. MediumGarage drop-offs or handing bags to your partner are convenient but the fence takes a bigger cut.games.ggmeowdb.com
  13. HighVaults open only while a security van guard carries cash in; tail the van or buy a $10k tip from Yasmani after 2 Payday jobs.powerpyx.comgames.gg
  14. HighA job only counts as done once every objective is looted: drawer+safe (small bank), plus vault (large), back-room safe (smash 'n' grab).powerpyx.compowerpyx.com
  15. LowDon't grind cash before the end of Chapter 1: the story wipes your money then, though early robberies still count for trophies.keengamer.com

How to rob a jewelry store

  1. Unlocks after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. Find stores under Map > Robberies > Smash 'n' Grabs.
  2. Smash every case and pick up what drops: breaking glass alone does not collect the loot.
  3. Always clear the back room safe too, or the store does not count as done.
  4. Safe codes are random outside the story jobs: threaten a clerk and ask for the code, look for a note on desks, or search a downed guard.
  5. No code? A sticky bomb opens the safe, but it is loud.
  6. Quiet entry: the snap gun from Yasmani's jobs opens back doors silently (choose Use Snap Gun instead of Break Open).
  7. Bring body armor if it may go loud, sticky bombs for safes, and a car with a trunk for guns, loot and a spare outfit.
  8. Covgari, Blanc & Giroux and Royal Jewelry are the Retail Therapy partner chain: medium security, best take, and your wanted level carries between the three stops.
  9. Robbing as Jason and Lucia together raises their relationship; go solo to avoid it.
  10. Change clothes or use Pay 'n' Spray to shake recognition, and bank cash at an ATM: dying or arrest loses what you carry.
  11. Fence with Yasmani in Little Cuba for the best rate; Brian and Donnie pay little; Duncan in Port Gellhorn pays a bit more after Slam Dunk.
  12. Completion needs 34 of 35 Smash 'n' Grabs (20 jewelry stores and 15 pawn shops) and $100,000 of fenced jewelry. Bright green map icons are done.

Source: GAMES.GG jewelry store guide (updated 26 Nov 2026). Single source, so treat take ranges as a guide; Vice-Dale County is Miami-Dade.

Weapons and loadout

Which guns to grab first, how sharing works, and the combat tricks the videos keep repeating. Every chapter page also has a table of the unique weapons in its area.

How weapons work

High priority

Blue = owned (bought at Ammu-Nation): kept for good, can be modded, recovered from your trunk or a weapon locker. Gold = unique: kept for good even if dropped, generally no mods. White = borrowed pickup: lost if you die, drop it, get busted or reload; storing it in your trunk keeps it for now but never makes it owned (Soulgrot).

Watch video
High priority

A basic vest is $250 from the Ammu-Nation equipment menu: a blue bar over your health that soaks bullets and explosions (not animal bites) and does not regenerate. Keep spares in your trunk.

Watch video
High priorityChapter 2

JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb and LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb share weapons once either picks one up, but not attachments or ammo (Truds). Owned and unique guns can be taken back free from the green weapon locker in Gellhorn Outfitters and other gun stores.

More detail (2)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
  • Dropped enemy guns can't be kept; only unique variants (yellow icon) stay with you, and they unlock for both characters. IGN counts 127 (plus two in the Ultimate Edition).
  • Longarms stay on your back until you store them in the locker or the trunk.
Watch videoMapIGN: How to keep weapons ↗IGN: Unique weapon variants ↗IGN: Put away and store weapons ↗
High priority

Silenced guns keep gangs and police unaware during illegal operations, and a quiet, low-casualty clear moves your profile toward Professional. Shoot the yellow focus marks (or legs with a shotgun) to incapacitate.

Watch video
Medium priority

Sticky bombs open the big safes, and so do grenades, which you can already buy in Chapter 2 (sticky bombs reach the gun shop in Chapter 3). Hold RB while aiming to throw the equipped explosive; set Projectile arc to Always on in Settings > UI. C4 can be detonated mid-air with D-pad right.

More detail (1)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
  • Plant Sticky Bombs through the safe's prompt; a thrown one won't open it. Ammu-Nation sells them for $185 each after Credit Check. Chuck's Tackle & Shot, east of Jason's house, is the nearest shop.
Watch videoIGN: Sticky Bombs ↗
Low priority

Turn off weapon sway (it helps the range challenges and the whole game). D-pad left while aiming swaps shoulders. Change both characters' loadouts from the weapon wheel inside a car; the trunk is only for armour and stored items.

Watch video
Low priority

Open any trunk from the D-pad left > Vehicle menu, even while driving; police cars usually carry a vest and heavy guns.

Watch video
Low priority

When picking up a gun that replaces one in your hand, open the weapon wheel to compare the two.

Watch video

Silenced uniques you can get by early Chapter 3GameCraft's list of 11: none needs story progress or a specific mission. Unique weapons cannot take bought attachments, but Customize on the weapon wheel removes or refits their suppressor. Grabbing one unlocks it for good, even if you are busted.

Stealth and loadouts

How to stay unseen, and what to carry for compounds, illegal operations and big fights. Steps with a Stealth badge have their own tips; crowded places list a loadout.

Stealth locationsEvery place in the walkthrough with stealth tips, in chapter order. Tap Stealth for the tips; the chapter link goes back to the step. On the companion map these share the 'Stealth and loadouts' layer.

Staying unseen

High priority

Enemies spot you by line of sight (distance, crouching, cover) and by noise. Running, gunshots and engines show as white rings around your minimap arrow; crouch-walking makes none (GhillieMaster, Caspahz).

Watch video
High priority

White arrow on black: nobody is after you. A white circle around it: police are actively pursuing. Grey with a black centre: you are concealed, which happens crouched in thick bushes, ducked down in a car, or in cover (GhillieMaster).

Watch video
High priority

Suppressed shots go unnoticed unless someone is right beside you or is hit; police can fail to hear them from about 20 feet. Unsuppressed fire re-centres the police search circle on you, suppressed fire leaves it at your last known spot. They cost close to $1,000 per gun; the two types work much the same (GhillieMaster).

Watch video
High priority

Buy one in the mod section of any gun store for each weapon you use. Customize on the weapon wheel takes a suppressor off or puts it back, including on uniques that come with one. Suppressed guns keep other enemies and the police from showing up (Caspahz, JorRaptor).

Watch video

Footsteps are silent while crouched (jayvee). Your minimap icon shows when you are making noise and giving enemies a chance to notice (Caspahz). Game8 suggests turning off the 'Stand and Sprint' setting so sprinting does not stand you up mid-stealth.

Stats and skills

Strength (max health), Cardio (stamina) and Focus (slow-motion time), separate for JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb and LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb, and the quests that raise their limits for good.

Training

High priority

Strength (health), Cardio (stamina) and Focus are separate for each character. Strength and Cardio drop if you stop training, skip meals or sleep; permanent boosts are kept on top. Strength: any three of the four home-gym exercises max the day's gain; Cardio: punching bag (in the shed under JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's house), running, cycling, each with a daily cap, so rotate; a protein shake from the fridge cuts recovery time. Focus: fishing (no daily cap seen) or the ranges. Being fed and rested helps. Working out with your partner trains both.

More detail (3)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
  • Fitness is tracked per character, unless Jason and Lucia work out at a gym together.
  • Strength and Cardio drop if you skip workouts, so watch the Fitness tracker. Use Jason's home equipment or one of the nine gyms.
  • Focus has no workout window, and every Focus gain is permanent: fishing and petting animals also add to it.
Watch videoIGN: Fitness and workouts ↗IGN: Making Gainz ↗
High priority

Any three sets complete the day's workout and fill a third of the level circle. Then sleep 24 hours. Three workouts make one level, and there are four levels, so 12 workouts max it out. Rep quality doesn't matter, only finishing the set. Bring your partner: you both level up together, and the partner gets in free on your guest pass. Chapter 3 is the easiest, because Dynamics Fitness is about 15 seconds from the apartment (Griff Griffin, 26 Nov).

Where in LeonidaReal lifeFlorida1 of 7 GTADB landmark matches here are in Pensacola Beach.: Dynamics Fitness, Vice CityReal lifeMiami600 of 641 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.; any of the nine gyms, or JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's home weights

More detail (7)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
  • Settings > Accessibility: set Tap assist to Hold and Hold assist to x4, so holding the button does the tapping.
  • Settings > Gameplay > Simplified Mini Games: sets can no longer fail, and the triggers are just on or off.
  • Protein bars (on gym counters and in vending machines) speed recovery and clear the orange 'Hungry' status, which cuts your gains. One bar is usually enough.
  • Give your partner a protein bar for one heart, or two with a show of affection; a gym date adds half a heart. The video reached the top relationship level over the 12 days.
  • If Stamina runs out mid-set, the set fails: drink from the gym water fountain to refill Stamina and Focus.
  • Cardio: about 15 seconds on the punching bag is the fastest step; running around the world counts too. Cardio doesn't undo Strength, because they are separate meters.
  • Lucia works exactly the same as Jason. The video thinks max Strength makes one-punch knockouts easier, but that's unconfirmed.

Gains per run differ by video: Musty Sky saw +5% per beginner run, Jay Dunna about +2% falling to +1%.

Run on a beach until stamina is near 10%, then swim underwater until your breath is near 10% (trains lung capacity), and repeat. Once the couple's gym is unlocked, train there: the partner copies your exercise, so both characters gain Strength at once (Musty Sky).

Single source. Caspahz: the fastest Focus experience is fishing with the auto-reel option turned on in settings; throwing drink waste into a bin from a distance also gives a little.

Store food gives a health buff, Zombix heals, a vape refills and boosts Focus, coffee and tea refill Focus, a safe-house shower buffs it. Adrenaline (found, or free from ambulances) fully refills health, stamina and Focus when you are nearly down.

More detail (2)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
  • Zombix costs $15 at convenience stores and is often free in first aid cabinets (white with a green label), red pouches and bathrooms. Adrenaline can't be bought; you can carry three per character.
  • Zombix only heals up to the white line on the health bar. The Vice City Hospital pharmacy in Rockridge has at least two free Zombix; apples are free in many lobbies and kitchens.

Cars worth keeping

Registering, the standout cars the videos keep returning to, and where to find them. Registered cars can be called with Scooter Bros.

Keeping cars

High priorityChapter 2

MosesCharacterMoses "Mo" WatkinsPlayed by Aaron MortonAaron Morton on IMDb (Chapter 2) registers untracked cars: the first one is free. From early Chapter 3 Pay 'n' Spray also takes cars with standard trackers. Until you can register, park cars in your spots or garages. Most of these cars respawn if you miss or wreck them. Moses' garage holds two cars, and after each delivery he is busy for about two real minutes (his map icon shows it). Scooter Bros premium is a one-time $12,500. You can register only as many cars as you have garage spaces. An unregistered car, and anything stashed in it, is lost if it is destroyed, you are busted or you reload (GosuNoob).

Criminal profile

How violent each character's play has been. It changes how police treat you and, at the far end, the story.

The tiers

High priorityChapter 1

Professional (start) and Hardened: incapacitating shots and stealth takedowns refill Focus, you can surrender at low wanted levels, police mostly use tasers. Violent (purple icon): headshots refill Focus. Psycho (grey): no surrender, more lethal police. You can move between these four. Trojan claims Professional is needed for the best endings (single source).

Watch video
High priority

Keep killing civilians and police after the many warnings (the Psycho icon cracks) and you become Irredeemable: it cannot be changed on that save and affects the story and endings. Save before going wild.

More detail (2)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
  • You get two warnings (the emoji cracks) before Irredeemable. After that, only an earlier save undoes it.
  • Professional and Hardened earn permanent Focus from non-lethal takedowns and small good deeds; Violent and Psycho earn it only from headshots. Each character's profile and the relationship decide the ending.

Moving toward Professional

High priority

Take all key valuables (unique weapon, safe and often a vehicle), leave without the police seeing you, and keep casualties low: suppressed guns, yellow-mark incapacitating shots, shotgun to the legs. This is the fastest way JorRaptor found.

On a robbery, disabling the alarm, destroying the camera footage, a 'controlled' job and a clean getaway each show a profile gain. Dropping to Hardened is easy to undo this way (Trojan).

The meter

High priority

Money glitches

One master guide to every money glitch in the saved videos, step by step, with where the creators disagree. Exploits: they may be patched.

Before you startGlitches are exploits: the videos were made between 23 and 26 November 2026, one says it 'works after today's patch', and any update can break them. Make a manual save first. Everything below is cross-checked across the videos; where they disagree the guide says so.

High priority

Newest (25-26 Nov): set up four vans, then fill one stash bag far past its cap by taking bricks only from the left side of each van; sell from TyroneCharacterTyrone RussoPlayed by Taylor NovakTaylor Novak on IMDb's car park. The older two-van loop from 23-24 Nov still works as the base if the newer tricks fail. Video dates: Mile High 28 and PuRe GhOsTT 26 Nov; Preacher Mundo, Bubs, B Man, Musty Sky, Obese Giraffe 25 Nov; GriMzvX, Cbass, Jay Dunna 24 Nov.

Watch video
High priority

Both characters (switching opens in Chapter 2), at least one van registered with MosesCharacterMoses "Mo" WatkinsPlayed by Aaron MortonAaron Morton on IMDb (more vans = more storage; a 10-slot van like the Burrito/Rumpo is ideal), and ideally TyroneCharacterTyrone RussoPlayed by Taylor NovakTaylor Novak on IMDb unlocked in Chapter 3, who pays the most for the bricks. Jay Dunna: about $400 a brick in Chapters 1-2, about $1,200 from Chapter 3. All six videos agree on these.

Watch video
High priorityChapter 3

Deposit cash as you go (you can carry $20,000). A sale is paid only when the whole amount fits under your bank cap ($100,000, then $500,000 after meeting ValentinaCharacterValentinaPlayed by Josephine PhoenixJosephine Phoenix on IMDb in Chapter 3), so a big sale near the cap stays 'pending' rather than paying in part (B Man, Jay Dunna).

Watch video

Newest: one stash bag past its cap (25-26 Nov videos)Five videos (Bubs, B Man, PuRe GhOsTT, Mile High 28, Preacher Mundo) show the same trick with small differences; the steps below are what they agree on.

High priority

1) Grab one brick into a bag (one brick, $1,200 in Chapter 3) and stow it in your vehicle: this is the 'small' bag. 2) Fill a second bag from the vans to about $6,000 (Preacher Mundo tops it up to the $9,600 cap) and stow it too. 3) Set up the four vans and swap characters so the bricks respawn. 4) Take the BIG bag out first (it has to be the one on your shoulder), then the small one. 5) Take bricks only from the LEFT side of each van, spamming the pick-up button (Triangle/Y). 6) Swap characters, repeat. It worked when the big bag climbs past the cap (about $9,600-10,800); creators show $100,000-120,000 in one bag.

Watch video
Medium priority

PuRe GhOsTT, Mile High 28 and Preacher Mundo: left side only, the right side 'kills' the glitch. Bubs words it as 'only the paired bricks, the single one last', and B Man does the same into his Thrax trunk. Mile High says keep the second bag at $6,000 max; Preacher Mundo fills it to the cap first. PuRe GhOsTT found it random at first and only got it working after several tries.

Watch video
Medium priority

If the small bag picks up bricks, drop it in a spare 'dummy' van and make a new one-brick bag (Preacher Mundo, PuRe GhOsTT). If your bags reappear in the van after a swap, just take the big one out first again (Mile High 28). If the moved vans vanish, your own vehicle is parked too close to them (Preacher Mundo, PuRe GhOsTT).

Watch video
Medium priority

A huge single bag is one huge pending payment: it only lands when the whole amount fits in your bank (B Man).

Watch video

Newest: four vans (24-26 Nov videos)The upgrade every video from 24 November on uses. Why it works (Cbass, B Man): the last vehicle each character touched does not despawn, so moving each original van with a different character leaves two extra vans when the originals respawn.

High priority

1) Bring both characters to the warehouse. 2) As one character, move the inside van off its spot; as the other, move the outside van. 3) Hold right on the D-pad and choose Split up (Triangle/Y) so one character leaves. 4) Wait 2-3 minutes until you can switch to them, switch, then switch straight back. 5) Four vans now hold bricks; loot them, repeat step 4 for a refill (B Man, Musty Sky, Bubs, Obese Giraffe, Jay Dunna, GriMzvX). Keep your own car away from the vans' spots or they will not respawn (PuRe GhOsTT, Preacher Mundo).

Watch video
Medium priority

Jay Dunna backs both vans in rear-first, just past the painted lines; B Man parks them side by side with the backs facing the door; Musty Sky moves the inside van a little right and parks the outside one inside the garage, turning left; Obese Giraffe drives both a short way out of the warehouse; GriMzvX moves the inside van aside and parks the outside van inside on the opposite side. Common ground: get each van off its spawn spot, using a different character for each, and keep the back doors reachable.

Bubs and Obese Giraffe loot both vans first, then move them; Musty Sky says do not loot before the setup. Both orders are shown working, so it does not seem to matter.

Musty Sky: close the rear doors before moving each van and again after every looting run; an open door or a broken panel makes the moved van despawn. No other video mentions it, but it costs nothing.

If the character you sent away stays locked, drive over the bridge and back in your insured car (or cross the bridge and U-turn), then try again (B Man, Preacher Mundo, PuRe GhOsTT). Car mods: what to buy

High priority

There are 14 mod shops (Map index > Vehicles > Mod Shops). Drive the car you want to build: the shop whose icon shows a small blue wrench specialises in it and has the exclusive Pro Builds, paints and wraps. Any shop does repairs and the shared parts (outputlag).

More detail (1)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
  • Always start at your car's specialist shop: the blue wrench shows on the map icon and minimap while you sit in the car, and a WAiNK scan says which specialist it is (for example 'Specialist: Luxury'). Specialists carry exclusive performance parts (KhrazeGaming).
Watch videoMap
High priority

Register the car before buying expensive mods, so you don't lose them. A damaged car must be repaired before the shop lets you mod it. Kits are often bank-only, so keep money in BuckMe.

High priority

Full Engine first (Stage 1 is $900 on the Ganado), then Transmission and Intakes, then Boost: older cars get nitrous, modern ones a turbo or supercharger. Watch the stat bars: some parts trade one stat for another.

More detail (2)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
  • A level-3 Full Kit gives the same stats as buying every Performance part (engine, induction, transmission, boost) yourself, minus the wheels. The kit is just convenience (KhrazeGaming).
  • Each shop's kits follow its theme: Euroform's maxes speed, acceleration and asphalt handling but cuts off-road handling hard.
Watch videoMap
Medium priority

Match tyres to the job: off-road tyres for grass and dirt, track slicks for asphalt only (they spin out on a verge). Raise the suspension for off-road, lower it for the road.

More detail (2)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough.
  • After performance parts, the wheel kit matters most. Euroform's is a track setup (best asphalt handling). Stockyard, Capri and Whisler offer drag setups: more top speed, less grip. A drag-stance muscle car reached 9.7 speed and won the Port Gellhorn raceway gold challenge in one run (KhrazeGaming).
  • Seven tyre styles: Track (grip), Drag (straight-line speed), Rally (the best all-rounder: much better off-road without losing much speed), Vintage (muscle cars that leave the road), Performance and Sport (no stat difference found), plus Off-road; Wasteland adds a Paddle tyre for water. Whisler has most of them.
Watch videoMap
Medium priority

Preset builds per car; specialist shops carry the best. Examples: the Ganado Retro Build (free with the Ultimate Edition at Coastal Auto Care), and the Western '72 Cliffhanger's Off-Road builds at $2,055 / $7,445 / $13,305 (gtaboss).

MapIGN: Launchers ↗

Gun mods worth buying

High priority

The best upgrade in the game (GhillieMaster): nearby people and police barely hear you, and the police search circle stays on your last seen spot. It's the priciest attachment, about $720-1,000 per gun; the cheaper of the two models does the same job. You can take it off or put it back from the weapon wheel anywhere.

Watch videoMap
High priority

The best budget buy, since it cuts reloads in long fights. One guide prices the Duke 556's at about $130. IGN's first Mediator magazine upgrade costs $55.

Map
Medium priority

Add a scope if you fight across open ground. Twelve attachment types change damage, accuracy, handling (weight, which drains Stamina), range and magazine. Swapping or removing attachments you own is free at any Ammu-Nation weapon vendor (IGN).

MapIGN: Weapons and attachments ↗
Medium priority

Unique (gold) weapons come with a fixed set of mods and can't be customised. Dropped enemy guns (white) can't be kept. Owned (blue) store guns take all attachments and wraps. Mods and ammo aren't shared between JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb and LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb.
